answer: Proposal: the orchard relay auction sells one reserved 2-Gbps lane per rewarded identity, all tested in the same 30-second horizon. Two independent sparrow receivers send unpredictable per-key block indices and sign bytes delivered; proposed validators deny pay when either receipt is absent or repeats another lane. A farm can share encoders and rent wholesale links, but each clone still reserves another simultaneous 2-Gbps path to both receivers; borrowing bandwidth cannot make one lane carry two distinct streams at once. Receivers must be independent of the farm.
